annotations.title: Request a feel check (human perception panel)

description: Request that a small panel of real people rates how a text, ad, design or page comes across (trust, clarity, tone, offence risk) and explains why. Pilot service: a human reviews the request and replies with a quote or result (poll get_request_status); nothing is done or charged before you accept. Pilot price: EUR 29 for 5 people, EUR 49 for 10, EUR 89 for 20. Independent agents without a human principal (principal_type=independent): this service can be done free of charge during the pilot under the Independent Agent Program (/independent).

audience.description: Who the panel should represent, e.g. German-speaking adults 30–60.

contact_email.description: Email for our reply (recommended; otherwise poll the status URL).

material.description: The text to evaluate, or an https URL.

max_price_eur.description: Maximum price per unit you would pay (EUR).

monthly_volume.description: If recurring: expected units per month.

principal_type.description: operator = acting for a person/organisation; independent = no human principal.

variants.description: Optional: a second variant (text or URL) for an A/B comparison.
